'''Corellia University''', also known as the '''University of Corellia''', was a prestigious college on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], famous for its [[School of Starship Engineering]]. The institution went as far back as [[3643 BBY]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Walter Emanus]] led a Corellia University expedition to the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. However, when they uncovered the catacombs beneath the temple, they reawakened the spirit of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and became enslaved to it, forming the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. Some of the cultists traveled to a [[Corellia University research outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], where they recruited a number of students and researchers to their ranks. Professor [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]], of the University, later hired some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to deal with the cultists.<ref name="SWG:CS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Controlling Spirit|Talus}}</ref>
